scope: source-only public frontend journey audit; browser/runtime verification owned by parent

findings.title: Product links turn inventory outages into Not Found
findings.impact: Valid shared product links appear removed during inventory API failures and have no retry action.

trace.detail: useInventory destructures inventory, isLoading, and refetch only.
Loading is handled, then any missing item becomes Not Found.
Shop already has a separate error and retry state.

findings.smallestRemedy: Branch on inventory query error and expose refetch; reserve Not Found for a successful query without the item.

findings.title: Storefront product failures are presented as a store with no stock
findings.impact: A failed store catalog request tells customers the merchant has not published inventory and offers no retry.

trace.detail: Products query captures data and isLoading but not error/refetch state.
Only loading is passed to StorefrontShopSection.
An empty list renders the stock-preparation message.

findings.smallestRemedy: Pass the products query failure and refetch through, separating failure from successful empty inventory.

findings.title: Find-a-table review badge always falls back to Verified
findings.impact: The review query is rejected and directory rows display an unsupported status; the count cannot represent distinct teas per store.

trace.detail: Review query expects an object with reviews.
Worker requires tea_key, product_id, or source_sample_id and returns 400 without one.
Caller reads reviewsData.reviews, but worker returns a raw array.
Count increments per row; the computed tea key is discarded.
Zero count becomes the Verified badge.

findings.smallestRemedy: Use a directory-level aggregate endpoint or remove the unsupported badge; distinct tea counting needs a defined aggregate contract.
findings.runtimeProof: Parent browser pass observed GET /api/tea-reviews returning 400 on /find-a-table.

nonFindingConcern.title: Public shop makes an unnecessary protected admin products request

trace.detail: Calls useProducts() without the computed admin enabled flag.
Public inventory is supplied by the separate public-product hook.

nonFindingConcern.impact: Unauthenticated /shop sends an unnecessary request that returns 401; the public catalog continues to load through its intended endpoint.
